bot_doi.mo_ta: Most of the original low, compact Rock and its sandy base are removed or replaced by a much larger, differently shaped cliff mass. A small original town-and-slope fragment remains suspended near the top.
Original distant green headland across the upper-right sea is removed; its former position is now sky.
The broad continuous original plain and field pattern are replaced by a coastal camp, town, mountain and two bays. Only sharply bounded rectangular strips of the original fields remain.
Original small tree and shrub groups across the left middle ground are removed, with their positions becoming sea, beach or new terrain.
Original scattered trees down the left foreground are removed or replaced by the new tent, rocks, bushes and much larger tree.
Original tree groups near the middle-right shoreline and inland are removed.
Original prominent grove in the right foreground is removed and replaced by the beach, camp tents and new rocky terrain.
Original winding pale track through the lower-right field is removed or obscured by the replacement landscape and surviving rectangular patch boundaries.
Numerous original small grey rectangular field objects disappear wherever the central lane and new camp replace the render. Their exact kind is not resolvable.
Original small rectangular objects in the replaced right-hand fields are removed; others remain only inside the untouched diagonal-edged strips.

Original town, wall and small offshore vessels retain conspicuous fragments at their old screen positions but lose their original ground or sea context: the town and vessels now appear suspended against sky and the wall crosses the new cliff.

doi_loai_vung.mo_ta: LAND TO WATER: the left-hand original plain, including its scattered vegetation, becomes a broad sea inlet. The new shoreline runs from the foot of the invented Rock down toward the left foreground.
LAND TO WATER: a large part of the original right-hand plain becomes the harbour and right-hand bay, extending downward to the new curved beach.

WATER TO LAND: much of the original sea behind the plain is replaced by the enlarged Rock, its lower slopes, the invented town and fortifications. This box also contains some originally terrestrial areas because the changed coastline is irregular.
WATER TO LAND: new distant mountain ridges occupy a band that was open water in BEFORE.
WATER TO LAND/STRUCTURE: invented harbour piers and the outer mole occupy areas that were open water in the original frame.
